name: Release to short-form — drafts that cannot outrun the changelog

parameters.text:
Here is the release note for a new version of a product.

{{ $json.body }}

Write short-form material for it:

1. `script` - a 45-second spoken script. Concrete. Show the change, do not
   describe the excitement about the change.
2. `posts` - three variants, one per channel, no hashtag padding.
3. `claims` - every factual statement you made about what the release does.
   Each must be traceable to the release note above.
4. `could_be_misread` - one sentence on what a viewer might wrongly conclude.

Do not add a benefit the release note does not state. A launch video that
overpromises costs more trust than it earns attention.

Return JSON only:
{"script": "...", "posts": [{"channel": "...", "text": "..."}], "claims": ["..."], "could_be_misread": "..."}

nodes.name: Check every claim against the release

parameters.formDescription: Approve before anything is recorded or posted.

nodes.name: REVIEW — a person approves the script
